name: stateful-storage-errors
description: Critical storage errors for stateful services (ENOSPC, read-only FS, disk pressure) in mereka-lms namespace.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND (textPayload:"no space left on device" OR textPayload:"Read-only file system" OR textPayload:"ENOSPC" OR textPayload:"disk pressure" OR jsonPayload.message:"no space left on device" OR jsonPayload.message:"Read-only file system")
